head: Moonlock for iPhone checks scam texts, links and QR codes
dek: MacPaw's security app Moonlock is now on iPhone: it checks suspicious texts, screenshots, links and QR codes for signs of phishing and explains why something looks like a scam. It also tells you if your email address showed up in a data breach.
details: Scam Detect checks content you paste, scan or share into the app. Safe SMS, which you switch on yourself, filters scam texts and keeps a record of what it caught and why. A Security Score from 0 to 100 rates your iPhone's setup and checks things like Wi-Fi security, passcode and iOS updates, with step-by-step fixes. One device costs $13.50 a month billed monthly or $4.50 a month billed yearly; a one-time purchase is also offered, and Setapp subscribers get it for Mac and iPhone included.
where: iPhone, App Store, out now since 18 November
means: If you often get texts that might be scams, Moonlock gives a second opinion with a reason, instead of you guessing. It's a paid app, from $4.50 a month on the yearly plan.
todo: When a message looks suspicious, don't tap its link; share or paste it into a checker like this first. Check whether your email was in a breach and change the passwords of the accounts it names.
thumb_words: MOONLOCK CHECKS SCAM TEXTS ON IPHONE
